name: Liz Adams
title: Customer Success Manager
bio: Liz is a hard worker with a gift for solving problems and connecting with people. Before joining Smarty's Customer Success team, she worked as a recruiter at Southern Utah University, in the advisement center, and completed the Disney College Program at Disney World. Whether she's answering a tough question or making someone's day easier, Liz brings energy, empathy, and excellence to everything she does.

name: Andrea Allan
title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
bio: Andrea Allan is one of Smarty's Enterprise Customer Success Managers. Known for her tireless drive, infectious positivity, and deep commitment to seeing both customers and colleagues succeed, she's the kind of person who somehow makes work feel lighter and brighter. Always quick with a smile, Andrea thrives on solving complex problems. You'll often find her collaborating across teams, chasing down answers, and going the extra mile to fully answer the question, "Why does this matter for my customer?" She's an advocate for her customers, a champion for the tools her team needs to succeed, and a relentless seeker of deeper understanding. Even after a successful project, she's still asking, "How can I do even better next time?" Her passion for people runs deep. Andrea believes that people are art—each one worth understanding, connecting with, and celebrating. It's that belief that fuels her work and her life, whether she's driving enterprise success, mentoring teammates, or creating beauty through pottery, painting, and cooking. It's people like Andrea who make Smarty a truly great place to be.

name: Brady Amundson
title: Video Audio Content Manager
bio: As our Marketing Content Creator, Brady does a great job at conveying all the benefits of using Smarty, in a fun and creative way. You've maybe seen some of our fun commercials ads or our entertaining informative videos. Those are all thanks to Brady! With a BS in Behavioral Science and a background in performing improvisational comedy, Brady does an amazing job of not only communicating to customer needs but doing so in an interesting way. It's this unique mix of skills and talents that have led Brady to not only create excellent content for Smarty, but also for a variety of YouTube creators and television shows. We love having Brady on the Smarty team as he helps us market Smarty intelligently and entertainingly!

name: Bryan Amundson
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Bryan's several decades of experience as a software engineer has been integral to our success here at Smarty. Previous to Smarty, Bryan worked at Novell where he used Java, C#, Javascript, C++, Python, and PHP to create various custom software projects entailing identity provisioning, authentication, and password management. He also worked on a team who wrote a framework for integration testing of systems using LDAP, Database, and REST APIs. And Bryan's wealth of experience and knowledge made it possible for us to create our US Autocomplete Pro API.

name: Trisha Andersen
title: Small-Medium Business Sales Team Lead
bio: Before joining Smarty, Trisha was a school administrator in Arizona, earning her MBA while raising her family. That experience cemented her belief that good leadership comes from empathy, grit, and an organized spreadsheet. (Few things make her happier than color-coded cells.) Trisha got invested in client relations because she was drawn in by the question, "How can I make this easier for people?" That question drives her daily as she helps businesses navigate contracts, optimize their plans, and find the sweet spot between what they need and what they'll actually use. As a Small-Medium Business Team Lead at Smarty, Trisha thrives on helping small and mid-sized businesses succeed—the kind of companies that often get overlooked in favor of the big enterprise fish. She loves giving them the same white-glove attention, making sure every lookup, every process, and every interaction adds real value. She also channels her educator roots into mentoring others and building efficient, people-first processes. Her mantra? When there's a clear process, everyone wins—expectations are clear, mistakes are easier to fix, and success becomes repeatable.

name: Hannah Arnold
title: Sales Administrator
bio: Hannah Arnold is Smarty's Sales Administrator and the kind of person who makes process, paperwork, and team support feel downright delightful. With a background in education and administration—including six years as the Administrative Assistant at Cedar Valley High—Hannah brings calm, clarity, and a love of well-oiled systems to every task. But it's not just her knack for organization that makes her stand out. Hannah's ever-happy demeanor and can-do attitude are ever-present. Whether she's coordinating behind the scenes or lending a hand with a big, beautiful smile, Hannah's the kind of teammate who makes the whole office run smoother (and brighter).

name: Wes Arnold
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Wes oversees all marketing efforts that are non-search related at Smarty. If you've received one of our fun emails or perhaps a gift in the mail from Smarty, you can thank Wes and his creative approach for it! Prior to Smarty, Wes worked for several years at TestOut as a Product Marketing Manager and Demand Generation Manager where he helped TestOut grow exponentially. He also worked at Certiport as a Product Marketing Manager where he helped create strategic marketing plans and drive demand for technical certification programs offered by global technology enterprises including several fortune 500 companies. Wes has an incredible ability and years of experience in finding fun ways to convey value and solutions to customers, and Smarty is better for it!

name: Jayden Backus
title: Release Engineer
bio: Jayden Backus, one of our wonderful IT Professionals, is currently advancing his knowledge in Technology Management at Utah Valley University (UVU). Known as the 'technology doctor', Jayden expertly handles the purchasing, managing, and distributing of our technology, ensuring operational efficiency and productivity. Outside of his professional realm, he is a culinary enthusiast with a penchant for sampling Mac and Cheese at various restaurants and enjoys unwinding with video games and music. His blend of technical expertise and diverse interests makes him a vital asset to the Smarty team.

name: Braxton Barham
title: Video Editor and Motion Graphic Artist
bio: As our designated Motion Graphics Artist and Video Editor, Braxton is the resident expert in all things motion. From simple animated graphics to complex video productions, Braxton happily resides in the digital worlds behind his computer screen. That includes things like 3D modeling, sculpting, texturing, rigging, character animation, frame-by-frame animation, physics simulation, motion tracking, compositing, keying, color grading, video editing, and sound design… just to name a few. Being self-taught, Braxton gained his skills through real-world experience executing branding and marketing campaigns for both local and national clientele before finding his place at Smarty. He continues to grow his creative skills daily, partly to add to Smarty's creative chops, but mostly because he absolutely loves it.

name: Charly Barkey
title: Business Development Representative
bio: Charly Barkey is one of our amazing Business Development Representatives. She combines strategic insight with a unique personal flair. Beyond her professional skills, she excels in baking, perfecting lemon bars and chocolate chip cookies, and immerses herself in gaming, both video and tabletop. With a personal library of over 1300 books, her dedication to continuous learning enriches her approach to business development, making her a well-rounded and invaluable asset to any team.

name: Aaron Beenfield
title: Senior Analytics Engineer
bio: Aaron Beenfield is a seasoned data expert with seven years of experience delving into complex datasets to extract pivotal insights and advance business intelligence. With a robust commitment to standardizing business metrics and analytics methodologies, Aaron ensures that reporting is both precise and consistent across the board. As an alumnus of Utah Valley University, his expertise underpins a data-driven approach to decision-making that resonates with IT and data analytics professionals seeking to streamline operations and enhance strategic outcomes.

name: Brenyn Beesley
title: Manager, Business Development
bio: Brenyn makes a tremendous impact wherever she goes. She has made needles move at every company she's touched including Genesys, eLearning Brothers, and now Smarty. She volunteered at Kids On The Move teaching life skills and communication. With strong interpersonal abilities, she now works in Smarty's Sales department and is a student at Utah Valley University.

name: Cassandra Bigler
title: Customer Success Manager
bio: Cassandra Bigler comes to us with an extensive caregiving background with over seven years of tech industry experience. Transitioning from a Certified Nursing Assistant to her current role, Cassandra excels in building meaningful client relationships and tailoring solutions to meet unique needs. Her dedication was honed at a retail software company, where she helped small business owners integrate point-of-sale and website software. Outside work, she enjoys outdoor activities like hunting, fishing, and camping, and creative hobbies such as cross-stitching and crocheting plush toys.

name: Camí Blanch
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Camí joined Smarty after a chance lunch invite while studying CS at BYU with an animation emphasis. While animation was the dream, web development offered its own kind of artistry—and she took the leap into startup life, inspired by her father's own entrepreneurial path. We're glad she did. Camí Blanch brings a unique mix of creativity and precision to her work as a front-end developer at Smarty. From maintaining and optimizing the original jQuery site to rebuilding smarty.com with modern frameworks, Camí has been central to every major evolution of our web presence. Known for her fast, surgical debugging and love of a good challenge, she now focuses on improving CMS performance, mentoring teammates, and implementing data-driven content updates across our growing international site.

name: Andrew Blonquist
title: Software Engineer
bio: Andrew Blonquist is a highly skilled software engineer with a rich background in various programming languages, including JavaScript and Python. An alumnus of Southern Virginia University, Andrew began his professional journey at DevPipeline, where he made significant contributions as a software developer. His dedication to technological innovation and commitment to excellence caught the attention of industry leaders, leading him to join the engineering team at Smarty. Andrew's multifaceted expertise, combined with his deep understanding of software languages, positions him as a valuable asset in any project he undertakes. As a key member of the Smarty team, he continues to leverage his skills and knowledge to drive advancements in software development.

name: Derek Borsky
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Derek has always thrived in that space where technology, data, and experience intersect, whether by leading client strategy for a marketing research organization, or helping build a Fintech from startup to unicorn status. At Smarty, he gets to work alongside some of the most brilliant (and fun) people around to drive incredible value for our customers. In his spare time, he also loves exploring the beauty of the nearby mountains with his family, coaching youth sports, playing pickup basketball, VR gaming, and taking on home improvement projects.

name: Zyanya Bravo
title: SEO Specialist
bio: Zyanya is a skilled SEO professional. Her SEO career started at an agency, where she collaborated SEO efforts across multiple industries, building scalable processes and delivering data-backed strategies tailored to each client's unique needs. Known for her ability to rise to any challenge, Z has helped teams optimize performance through improved internal workflows. She brings her deep understanding of SEO to help drive smarter, more effective search strategies. Outside the world of keywords and rankings, Z transforms into a monster—literally. A self-taught special effects makeup artist, She loves bringing spooky and creative characters to life for some of Utah's creepiest haunted attractions! When not covered in fake blood, you'll likely find her exploring the city or mountains!

name: Briant Brown
title: Senior SEO Specialist
bio: With over a decade of experience in the digital marketing industry, Briant specializes in building and implementing SEO strategies that create sustainable, organic growth. His career has given him a diverse perspective in marketing, working everywhere from a marketing agency, non-profit organizations, to larger-scale B2B and B2C companies like SolarWinds, Vivint, and NRG.

name: Carter Brown
title: Small Medium Business Sales Representative
bio: Carter Brown is passionate about building meaningful connections and delivering solutions that enhance customer experiences. With professional experience coordinating nationwide travel for the FSY program at Brigham Young University and working as a Sales Representative specializing in promotional and apparel products, Carter excels at identifying and meeting customer needs with precision and care.

name: James Bryner
title: Accounting Clerk
bio: James joins our Finance Team with a strong passion for accounting. Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting from Brigham Young University, James brings a blend of academic knowledge and practical expertise to our team. When he's not immersed in numbers and financial reports, James enjoys playing basketball and pickleball, diving into a good book, or cheering on his favorite college football teams. His well-rounded interests and dedication to his studies make him a valuable addition to our organization.

name: Maxim Burov
title: Technical Support Representative, Tier II
bio: Maxim Burov is one of our brilliant Implementation Engineers, turning technical tangles into smoothe, elegant solutions. A BYU grad in Information Technology, Maxim works closely with clients to integrate and optimize address verification tools with confidence and precision—basically, he makes the complicated look easy. With a background in network infrastructure, system administration, and programming, Maxim brings both technical depth and a calm, can-do attitude to every challenge. He's the kind of person who reads error logs like some people read novels. Outside the office, Maxim stays quick on his feet—literally. He's a passionate soccer player, a mountain biking enthusiast, and always ready for an adventure. Born in Ukraine and raised on logic and adrenaline, Maxim's got a global perspective and a local impact. We're lucky to have him on the team.

name: Jerry Buss
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Jerry decided in 8th grade that he wanted to make real money by becoming a software engineer. Every day since he's been working to make that happen, eventually graduating from Brigham Young University with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. He came to us with over 35 years of programming experience and is looking forward to his next 35 years of top-notch programming skills! He has worked for various companies of various sizes in all sorts of industries including real estate, grocery, presentation software, medical software, and more. He's an expert in Fortran, assembly, LISP, C/C++, C#, and Go. If he won the lottery, Jerry would live on the golf course on a Caribbean beach.

name: Adam Charlton
title: Software Engineering Manager
bio: Adam Charlton's passion for his work shines through in the high quality of Smarty's products, especially our US-based offerings, many of which owe their success to his expertise. As a skilled data analyst, Adam has become Smarty's go-to resource for technical and detailed questions concerning address data and analysis across departments. Adam is uniquely equipped to tackle complex challenges. He consistently exceeds expectations, collaborating on and often leading difficult projects to successful completion. Adam's contributions have been instrumental to Smarty's success. While he insists he's happy where he is, we can't wait to see what else will come from his friendly, tenacious, and unique approach will bring to advancing Smarty's mission.

name: Jacen Christensen
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: With a history in marketing and advertising, Jacen brings a lot of exciting knowledge to Smarty. He's always wanted to work in software so it was a match made in heaven when he joined our team. He believes that "kindness + competence = success" and let us assure you, he's successful! You'll often find him camping, fishing, hiking, or spending time with his family. And who knows, you may one day read one of his books!

name: Scott Christensen
title: Manager, Technical Support
bio: Scott Christensen brings over 30 years of software customer service and technical support experience—and somehow makes it look easy. With a career built on problem-solving, smart collaboration, and just the right dose of innovation, Scott has a knack for turning complex challenges into smooth, customer-first solutions. Whether he's leading teams, managing projects, or fine-tuning systems, Scott's north star is always empathy. He knows that behind every technical issue is a person who just wants things to work—and he delivers with clarity, calm, and a lot of know-how. Outside the office, you'll find Scott in his happy places: working in the yard, boating on the lake, camping with his grandkids, or exploring new destinations with his wife.

name: Shayla Coombs
title: UX Designer II
bio: Shayla loves making workflows simple, seamless, and accessible. She holds a degree in cognitive science from the University of Michigan and a master's in UX from UW–Madison. Before joining Smarty, she handled client experience across sales, marketing, and onboarding roles, and founded her own software company to assist accounting firms. Originally from Michigan's Upper Peninsula, she now resides in Utah and pursues outdoor adventures.

name: Brighton Cox
title: Software Engineer
bio: Brighton is a software engineering intern at Smarty and a computer science student at Utah Valley University with a deep-rooted love for problem-solving. He's been programming for more than a decade and is endlessly curious about how things work—especially at the intersection of computer science and aerospace engineering. From building games to writing orbital calculation programs and maintaining libraries he actively supports, Brighton brings both technical depth and long-term thinking to his work. At Smarty, Brighton applies his experience across high-level languages like Rust, C#, Java, Python, and Go to help build reliable, well-crafted systems. His background includes supporting fellow students as a computer science teaching assistant, tackling hands-on technical challenges across campus roles, and contributing to real-world software projects.

name: Ryan Cox
title: Staff Engineer
bio: Ryan has a history of high-quality performance while problem-solving and team-building at large software companies along Silicon Slopes. You want experience? Ryan has experience. We're talking 61 years collectively in Java, Javascript, Typescript, SQL, Angular, AWS and loads more. As a key developer at each company he's ever worked at, he's keeping the ball rolling by improving the quality of work we do here at Smarty every day.

name: Mitchell Crane
title: Software Engineer
bio: Mitchell Crane is a Frontend Developer at Smarty, where he specializes in creating smooth, engaging web experiences that make users' lives easier. A problem-solver at heart, Mitch is passionate about crafting seamless applications and bringing fresh ideas to life. Outside the office, he shifts gears into hobbies like working on cars, tackling home and machine projects, snowboarding, mountain biking, and perfecting his golf swing. Whether he's coding or conquering the outdoors, Mitch is always up for a challenge.

name: Michelle Davis
title: Small Medium Business Sales Representative
bio: Michelle Davis is a skilled Business Development Representative with a talent for forging strong relationships and connecting businesses with tailored solutions. Drawing from her experience at &Collar and Pinnacle Quality Insight, she thrives on driving growth and uncovering opportunities in the fast-paced world of software. Her background in non-profit work adds a unique flair, giving her insight into mission-driven outreach and impactful communication. Outside of work, Michelle is a dedicated mother of five, a private piano teacher, a history enthusiast, and enjoys long walks to unwind.

name: Eric Devenport
title: Senior Technical Support Representative
bio: Eric Devenport, a Senior Technical Support Representative at Smarty, has been the go-to tech support guru in every role since high school. His unique combination of skills ranges from unicycling and mastering dungeons in D&D to handling the complexities of Linux server maintenance and server construction. In IT, Eric isn't just a support expert but also a programming aficionado, proficient in C++, C#, Java, and Python. His diverse skill set and passion for technology make him an invaluable asset to the Smarty team, providing top-notch support and innovative solutions to complex tech challenges.

name: Ben Dorton
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Ben comes to us with several years of full-stack development experience in Java, JavaScript, Ruby on Rails, NodeJS, GO, and more. He also has a passion for cybersecurity. His love for software engineering is tied to his love of building systems and solving puzzles (think word puzzles, "escape the room" or "exit" games, and logic puzzles... not jigsaw). When he's not coding, Ben loves to be outdoors and would work from the top of a mountain if he could find a long enough extension cord. He also loves movies, games, and his increasingly chaotic family.

name: Jeffrey Duncan
title: Senior Technical Analyst
bio: One of our proudest services that we provide at Smarty is our Customer Support. Jeffrey's leadership has helped us create a support team that focuses deeply on our customers and is dedicated to helping them find the right solution for whatever issue they are facing. Even before coming to Smarty, customer service was a professional focus of Jeffrey's. He's worked for several companies in roles where he managed online sales, created websites, led on complicated projects and more, all with a focus on what would best help the customer. Jeffrey now utilizes his dedication to customer service and applies it to technical product management.

name: Jonathan Duncan (Obi-Wan)
title: Senior Operations Engineer
bio: As our resident SmartAlek, Jonathan Duncan is a genius when it comes to "programming and stuff". He has more than 25 years of experience in the software industry specializing in Web/API development, Unix/Linux server administration, and much much more. What do we think of him? We think he's a stellar guy!

name: Lyle Durland
title: Pre-Sales Engineer
bio: Until Lyle came to Smarty, much of his prior customer experience came from the music world. Lyle taught several courses in classical music and jazz at Brigham Young University where he learned to adapt to help individual students achieve their unique outcomes. He's also worked as an independent music producer and small business owner where he's created and produced original music for film and television based on the needs of various stakeholders. Lyle's ability to take in feedback and create solutions, be them musical or technological, has made him an excellent customer support team lead at Smarty.

name: Timothy Eckstein
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Timothy's inquisitive nature has led him to a profound understanding of the intricacies of technology, fueling his passion for computer science at a fundamental level. With a strong background in C# and Assembly, his expertise is rooted in the core principles of programming. Prior to joining Smarty, Timothy honed his skills in the banking software industry. His commitment to excellence allowed him to create groundbreaking solutions and grow his career at an accelerated pace. Here at Smarty, he contributes his unique insights and knowledge to the team. When not doing fantastic work, Timothy loves spending quality time with friends, creating engaging games, and tinkering with electronics.

name: Benson Ehlert
title: Account Manager
bio: Meet Benson Ehlert, one of our adept Business Development Reps. He brings us his great ability to fuse business acumen with interpersonal finesse. His flair for problem-solving, friendly demeanor, and strategic insights drive growth and new possibilities. Here at Smarty his collaborative spirit, intellect, and team lifting dynamics make him an MVP. Outside work, he is a dedicated husband and father of three girls, blending professional drive with family support.

name: Rebekah Erikson
title: Software Engineer
bio: Rebekah Erikson is a standout on our front-end team and a dedicated Computer Science major with a Mathematics minor at Brigham Young University. She loves tackling homework challenges and is passionate about website development, often dreaming up creative solutions even off the clock. Outside of work, Rebekah is a record-holding pole vaulter for BYU's track and field team. She's also an accomplished pianist and enjoys wake surfing in the summer. Rebekah brings vibrant energy and fresh perspectives to everything she does, from coding to sports and beyond.

name: Mae Evans
title: Software Engineer
bio: Mae Evans is a computer science student at BYU and a software engineering intern at Smarty, where she brings curiosity, creativity, and a love of problem-solving to her work. What first drew Mae to programming was its puzzle-like nature—the satisfaction of breaking down complex problems and finding elegant solutions. Once she discovered how much creativity the field allows, she was fully hooked. Before joining Smarty, Mae worked as a backend developer at the BYU Law School, gaining hands-on experience building and supporting real-world systems. She has primarily coded in C++, Python, and JavaScript.

name: Brent Francom
title: Director of Product Management
bio: Tasked with keeping us at the leading edge of location data intelligence, Brent helps us grow market share and execute our product vision and strategy. He has a history of excellence as he's served in Assistant Vice President and Principal Product Manager roles at Verisk Property Estimating Solutions and XactAnalysis. He has a Bachelor's degree in Business/IT Education from Southern Utah University. We're super happy to have him on the team!

name: Easton Gibson
title: Software Engineer
bio: Easton came to us with several years of experience as a software developer, having coded in Go, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Flutter, Clojure, Python, Plait, Node, Rust, and others. Prior to Smarty, he worked at Brigham Young University where he developed a CS course from scratch, several products for the office of digital humanities, and taught a handful of lectures. Easton has also tutored in both math and computer science and loves to teach anybody who has cultivated a love of learning. He even dabbles in hardware design if he feels so inclined.

name: Kent Gividen
title: VP of Technology
bio: Kent provides us with decades of experience as a software engineer. Prior to Smarty he worked at Novell where he developed custom solutions for high profile customers as well as led his team on a number of consulting development engagements. Kent has also started a few of his own companies, so his experience in startups is also extremely valuable. Kent primarily works in Go at Smarty, but he's also worked in Javascript, Node, Angular, Java, JMS, SQL, Spring, jQuery, Novell Identity Manager, LDAP, HTML, CSS, and several other languages. We count on Kent's vast knowledge and skill set as we continue to make Smarty better every day.

name: Kevin Gutierrez
title: Senior Technical Support Representative
bio: Kevin Gutierrez is a tech enthusiast with a passion for bringing computer science to future generations. A graduate of BYU with a Bachelor's and a Master's in Information Systems, Kevin's journey spans from technical support at Smarty to business intelligence analysis at Fluent Solar. He's got skills in C++, Python, and AWS. He's not just about coding—Kevin thrives on inspiring others to dive into tech. When he's not solving complex data problems, he's co-directing Code Adventure, making coding fun and accessible for all.

name: Stewart Hagberg
title: Account Manager
bio: Stewart is a veteran in the software space beginning with an early start in Windows 3.0 and DOS, and growing into a teacher in the technical space through the early 2000s. After graduating from Brigham Young University he utilized his knowledge of technology, relationship building, and sales to his position as faculty at a local college. After years in the education sector, he joined Smarty and has been helping people see the value in our software ever since! When he's not building professional relationships you'll likely find him spending time with his wife and three children.

name: Dave Hale
title: Software Engineering Manager
bio: With decades of experience in programming and development, Dave is an incredibly helpful team lead. Dave has worked at companies such as Vivint and Adobe, where he built software systems for sales teams, dashboards for internal tracking and communications, and even built mapping visualizations for tracking data center locations and specifications. Dave also has experience in leading teams of developers, and we've found his focus on helping new talent grow and develop at Smarty immensely valuable.

name: Mark Hall
title: Software Engineer
bio: Mark Hall is an XR developer who specializes in building immersive AR and VR experiences with Unity and C#. With more than six years in extended reality, Mark has focused his career on creating applications that feel intuitive, responsive, and genuinely useful. He brings a steady, agile-minded approach to development, pairing strong technical execution with a sharp eye for UI and UX. Across roles in medical training, surgical navigation, neurocognitive assessment, and immersive collaboration, Mark has helped ship XR products to a wide range of devices and platforms.

name: Marc Hansen
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Marc Hansen is one of our seasoned account executives, bringing with him a wealth of experience from esteemed institutions such as ClickUp, Qualtrics, and Morgan Stanley. Renowned for his reliability and diligence, Marc has consistently proven himself to be an invaluable asset, especially in high-pressure situations. Outside the corporate arena, Marc showcases his artistic flair by crafting custom masks for renowned movie studios and illustrating distinctive character art, reflecting a harmonious blend of professionalism and creativity.

name: Blanche Harris
title: Social Media Marketing Intern
bio: As a Social Media Intern, Blanche loves to strategize, create, and stay up to date with everything happening online. She designs, writes, and ideates content briefs and campaigns that flow. As a current BYU Public Relations student, Blanche knows how to communicate effectively with targeted audiences. She's energetic, full of new ideas, and loves to be in the know!

name: Ben Hegerhorst
title: Account Executive
bio: Ben Hegerhorst is a key player on the Business Development Representative team at Smarty, bringing decades of sales expertise across various industries. From mortgages to industrial products, Ben's strong work ethic and goal-driven mindset have always set him apart. After navigating career shifts and cross-country moves—from Texas to Oregon and back to Utah—Ben returned home to support his family. Outside of work, he's an avid outdoorsman who enjoys camping, hiking, hunting, fishing, and hitting the open road on his motorcycle.

name: Bailey Hendrickson
title: Content Writer / Editor
bio: As our writer/editor, Bailey wears many hats. From crafting quirky blogs about how Star Wars relates to address validation to announcing our amazing new products in press releases, or using the perfect SEO keywords to rank on Google Search or AI Overviews, she's got writing in the bag. With a BS in English Education and an MBA, Bailey uses her skills for good, bringing light to Smarty's applications and ensuring the site is typo-free.

name: Sawyer Hendrickson
title: SEO Specialist
bio: You could say that Sawyer fell into digital marketing, but knowing what he knows now, he'd happily dive in. He works as our in-house SEO genius after plenty of years doing agency work. With a strong base in backlink building and technical SEO, he's known now for SEO-ing the crap out of Smarty's website. When he isn't at work, he enjoys running, cycling, swimming, or anything that gets him outside.

name: John Hickey
title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
bio: With over 30 years of marketing experience, John's goal is to deeply understand customer problems and needs so as to clearly communicate and share solutions that will actually help. John earned an MBA from the University of Arizona and has put it to good use. He has grown a startup to a $40 million annual run rate company, published more than 30 articles in industry publications, and helped optimize digital marketing for a Fortune 500 / Future 50 company. Family-focused with six children, he and his wife have recently become empty nesters.

name: Trent Howell
title: VP of Marketing
bio: Trent didn't get into marketing just to sell stuff—he was drawn in by the question, "Why do people choose what they choose?" That curiosity grew into a career leading high-performing teams with empathy and intention. Now, as VP of Marketing at Smarty, he brings a steady hand and people-first approach to everything from messaging to mentoring. Trent believes success hinges on how well you work with others. That means treating teammates, partners, and customers like real humans with goals, challenges, and ambitions. He leads with principles over trends, adaptability over rigidity, and opportunity over fear. Trent views change as a positive thing, and he ensures his team is prepared to evolve, remain curious, and take informed risks, even when the playbook changes mid-game. Because when your foundation is built on people, not just process, you don't just keep up. You lead.

name: Cierra Isom
title: PPC Specialist
bio: Cierra Isom is all about connections, solving problems, and making sure you've got a friend at work. After starting in IT and quickly realizing it wasn't for her, Cierra pivoted to communications and excelled in PPC marketing, managing a team of 14. Now at Smarty, she thrives in our 'outward mindset' environment and she genuinely looks forward to each week (and yes, the office slide helped seal the deal). Cierra is approachable and fun—so whether it's chatting about work, hair care, or video games, she's got your back and will make sure you feel welcome.

name: Thomas Isom
title: In-House Counsel
bio: Thomas lucked into his plum job as our In-House Counsel in the Smarty wonderland because someone at Smarty knew someone who also worked with Thomas at a legal tech company, and that person said Thomas was great. It also helped that Thomas brought three-and-a-half years of experience working for tech companies focused on making contract reviews better, faster, and cheaper through AI and that he has over two decades of experience working for companies as a lawyer. Thomas is a divorced solo parent of seven children. Parenting, not the law, has been Thomas's greatest calling in life.

name: Andrew Johnson
title: Software Engineer
bio: Andrew Johnson, a Computer Science graduate from Utah Valley University, brings a rich skill set in programming languages such as Python, C, and Java, among others. His academic highlight was a capstone project that designed a Virtual Machine and Compiler, deepening his appreciation for the intricacies of programming language development. Andrew kicked off his professional journey at a blockchain startup, where he developed a layer 1 blockchain in Go and pioneered a genesis ceremony for network initialization. Now transitioning to Smarty's Backend Product team, he is keen to apply his expertise in address verification solutions.

name: Xan Johnson
title: Software Engineer
bio: Xan Johnson is one of our wonderful software engineers with a strong foundation in software design and multiple programming languages. He is working on his Bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University, where he also served as a research assistant, contributing to academic projects that further honed his technical skills. Xan is proficient in a range of programming languages including Go, C++, and Python, and is well-versed in Git and Linux environments. His linguistic capabilities extend beyond programming languages to include fluency in French. His leisure activities, such as disc golf, reflect his commitment to strategic thinking and precision.

name: Eric Jones
title: Campaign Marketing Manager
bio: By day, Eric is planning, developing, and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns in order to generate quality leads for Smarty. He's a digital marketing nerd and a real sucker for marketing strategy. Coming from the agency world, he has 7 years of digital marketing experience and is well-versed in LinkedIn, Meta, and Google advertising. By night, you can find Eric with his wife and daughter. He enjoys watching movies, hiking, camping, playing guitar, and playing tabletop and video games alike. He's also an aspiring tabletop game designer and graphic novelist.

name: Kelly Jorgensen
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Kelly Jorgensen is a seasoned sales professional with over 15 years of that being focused on SAAS sales. Kelly is known for his ability to listen and understand what clients needs are in order to provide a real business solution. Kelly is not only focused on providing solutions to business challenges but on building long-term relationships to continue to be a value to those he is working with. When Kelly isn't working, he is usually found outside mountain biking, snowboarding, fly fishing, or anything else outside with his family.

name: Mikayla Kartchner
title: Data Acquisition Specialist
bio: Mikayla works in data acquisition at Smarty. A graduate of Brigham Young University, with a degree in geology and a minor in music, she brings both precision and creativity to her work. Outside the office, she's a dedicated multi-instrumentalist (piano, guitar, and violin), a voracious reader, and a film enthusiast who can quote just about any scene. Her Spotify playlists rival her rock collection in both size and variety.

name: Shaylee Kartchner
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Shaylee has been doing amazing things with her skills in many different areas. As a full-stack developer she worked in the computer vision research lab at BYU where she created an app that identifies various wildlife using machine learning. As an inclusion, diversity, and equity mentor she helped promote changes to the computer science industry, helping it become a place for people of all backgrounds to find success.

name: Dan Lambourne
title: Head of Employee Experience
bio: With over 20 years of experience as a leader in the customer service and financial industries, Dan brings a wealth of knowledge and skill to the table here at Smarty. He has led large groups to deliver consistently, resulting in exceptional performance and results. He specializes in training and developing people to be the best they can be, fully realizing their potential. He loves utilizing his degree in Human Resources to help others accomplish their own goals and live happier lives.

name: Stewart Larson
title: Technical Support Representative, Tier II
bio: Stewart Larson is a tech support pro with a translator's heart—fluent in both computer speak and real human language. For the past four years, he's been breaking down complex technical issues into bite-sized, easy-to-digest solutions for customers with the patience of a saint and the precision of a well-tuned script. Raised on the twin pillars of Windows XP and Mac OS X "Puma," Stewart has been tinkering with systems since floppy disks were still a thing. These days, he's fluent in C++, Python, HTML, and CSS.

name: Camden LeeMaster
title: Office Coordinator
bio: With a background rooted in group and corporate travel planning, Camden brings a love of travel, a wealth of organizational expertise, and a zeal for efficiency to every project. Her diverse professional journey includes roles as an executive admin, ski instructor, and even a pastry chef for a sorority house, alongside running her own successful home bakery business. At Smarty, Camden is committed to improving the experience of all team members through problem-solving, positive collaboration, and concierge-level service.

name: Brayden Lewis
title: Software Engineer
bio: Specializing with all things data, Brayden turns raw data into usable information that improves our products. He brings with him knowledge and experience in web development and data acquisition with a history as a private contractor. He has expertise in HTML and Javascript and enjoys working in Go, SQL, Alteryx, and anything else that helps with data processing. He is currently a student at Brigham Young University studying Information Systems.

name: Kiana Lewis
title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
bio: Kiana Lewis didn't expect to find herself in the tech world—but she's never been one to shy away from a challenge. After graduating from BYU with a degree in Communications and a minor in Ballet, she stepped into a temporary position at Smarty, doing data cleanup in HubSpot. What started as a side step away from public relations soon became a full leap into a career she loves. Today, Kiana helps bridge the gap between technical precision and customer understanding as an Enterprise Customer Success Manager. Her favorite part of working at Smarty? The people. She even met her husband here!

name: Adam Lutz
title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
bio: Adam Lutz is a seasoned Salesforce Administrator with four years of experience in enhancing business operations through his expertise in Salesforce. Renowned for his sharp problem-solving skills, he has a knack for streamlining operations, significantly boosting efficiency. His deep curiosity about different job functions within the company not only broadens his understanding but also drives him to develop innovative solutions to a variety of challenges.

name: Mike Manwill
title: Staff Engineer
bio: Mike's experience in building interfaces that customers can intuitively use has been invaluable for the frontend team. With past companies, Mike has helped create the frontend for CRMs, built web-based applications for University websites, developed improvements in company point-of-sales systems, and more. Here at Smarty, he uses his talents to help us build out our awesome frontend experience while leading and developing our frontend team with a friendly, positive, and intellectually nurturing presence.

name: Danielle McClure
title: Regulatory Document Coordinator
bio: Danielle brings a wealth of interpersonal expertise to her role as Regulatory Document Coordinator. With over 15 years in customer service, more than 5 years in real estate, and the life experience of raising five children, she adds a rare blend of warmth, resilience, and people skills to her work every day. She collaborates closely with Sales, Legal, Tech Support, and virtually every department across the company. Outside of work, Danielle stays just as active. She's often found caring for her kids, playing video games, exploring local history museums, or leading a soda run with anyone who's up for the adventure.

name: Kajsia McCoy
title: Product Marketing Manager
bio: Kajsia McCoy, an Orem native, has carved out a successful career in marketing with over a decade of experience across both B2C and B2B sectors. Besides leading a dynamic five-person team, she has also shared her creative spirit as a 7th-grade art teacher. Transitioning from graphic design to marketing, Kajsia discovered a passion for crafting precisely targeted messages that resonate perfectly with audiences. She's proficient in revamping brand identities, managing streamlined websites, optimizing SEO, and developing content strategies that have notably increased inbound leads by over 80%.

name: Taylor McKay
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Taylor McKay is a Senior Software Engineer at Smarty, where he builds fast, seamless web experiences using technologies like Next.js, Node.js, and Javascript. With nearly a decade of experience, Taylor specializes in creating high-performance websites that prioritize usability, speed, and a polished user experience. Before joining Smarty, Taylor spent over seven years at Beyond, Inc., leading frontend projects, mentoring developers, and improving site performance across major marketing initiatives. A former instructor at DevMountain, Taylor's passion for clean code and continuous learning drives his work today.

name: Jacob McKenzie
title: Software Engineer
bio: Jacob McKenzie is one of our amazing engineers, graduating from BYU with a BS in Computer Science and a 4.0 GPA. He co-founded Infosplain during his freshman year, developing a full-stack website now utilized by 25 Allstate agencies in Utah. Jacob's diverse career includes 1.5 years teaching ESL at Open English and two years in solar sales, showcasing his adaptability and communication skills.

name: Hannah Moore
title: Small Medium Business Sales Representative
bio: Hannah Moore is a Business Development Representative who doesn't just aim for growth—she dunks on it! A Brigham Young University graduate and former star of the BYU dunk team, Hannah is no stranger to high-flying tricks and big leaps, whether on the court or in her career. These days, she channels that same energy into building client relationships and uncovering opportunities with a flair that's uniquely her own. When she's not wowing clients, you'll find her boating, perfecting her stunts, or chasing sunsets by the water.

name: Brandon Mortensen
title: Graphic and UI Designer
bio: Brandon Mortensen is a dynamic designer with a flair for creative solutions. He's always had an interest in art and design and earned a degree in Art and Design along with a minor in Marketing from Utah Valley University (UVU). Brandon's collaborative nature drives him to seek feedback, ensuring his designs not only look great but also work effectively for the brand. He has experience spanning from managing marketing projects in an agency to building standout brand identities.

name: Ryan Muir
title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
bio: With more than a decade of marketing experience, Ryan has led a 6-person marketing team and trained multiple product marketing managers to run their own teams. During his time as a marketer, Ryan has driven 6 websites to the top search results, led the strategy for A/B testing and redesigns of 3 websites, and 10 checkout processes, and improved ROI on ad spend by 40%. Ryan has a track record of growing company revenue everywhere he goes.

name: Jacob Munson
title: Customer Success Manager
bio: Jacob Munson, with a decade of experience in customer service, has made significant strides in the sector, from starting on the front lines to managing teams and overseeing Sony Playstation's customer service division in Utah. His expertise in operations and customer satisfaction translated seamlessly into the financial sector, where he excelled in streamlining processes and handling complex customer cases. Outside of his professional life, he enjoys the balance of outdoor adventures like camping and hiking with his family and indoor hobbies, including video games, reading, drawing, and board games.

name: Julianna Nelson
title: Business Development Representative
bio: Julianna is a dynamic professional with a passion for fostering strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction. A proud graduate of Brigham Young University, she earned her Bachelor's in Exercise Science and worked in corporate wellness before transitioning into the tech industry as a Customer Success Representative. Julianna loves helping clients achieve their goals with her expertise and enthusiasm. Currently, she is pursuing her Master's in Public Health. When she's not busy at work or school, you can find her hiking, exploring new travel destinations, cooking, or attending a concert.

name: Matthew Nelson
title: Data Acquisition Specialist
bio: Matthew Nelson is a Data Acquisition Intern at Smarty and is currently completing his Master's degree in geology and planetary science at Brigham Young University. With a deep appreciation for the natural world and a mind trained to analyze it, Matthew brings a thoughtful, investigative approach to his work. His background in geospatial analysis, GIS, and SQL equips him to track down, evaluate, and refine the data that keeps Smarty moving forward.

name: Trisha Nelson
title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
bio: Trisha Nelson brings a blend of grit, heart, and curiosity to her work at Smarty. With a degree in recreational resource management, she once imagined a future in highway patrol. Life took her down a different path, beginning with DNR wildlife work and eventually leading her into the world of youth sports nonprofits. Her career has never been linear, and that's something she embraces. Beneath a quiet first impression is someone warm, open, and deeply driven by connection. After years of six-day workweeks, she has learned to fiercely protect the people who matter most—especially her four children.

name: Kiersten Nelthorpe
title: Software Engineering Manager
bio: Kiersten is one of our amazingly talented Software Engineers as well as our amazingly talented Data Engineer. Her past experiences in development with companies like Microsoft, Vivint, and Imagine Learning have helped us create excellent solutions for companies both big and small. Kiersten's accomplishments include building Microsoft API services for enterprise software, developing features for supply chain tools for Vivint, and building backend reporting APIs for Imagine Learning.

name: Smith Nielson
title: Technical Support Representative
bio: Smith Nielson is a Technical Support Representative at Smarty with a background in Information Systems from Utah Valley University, where he focused on application development. A lifelong tech enthusiast, Smith has always been drawn to solving real-world problems through technology. He thrives on troubleshooting complex issues—especially the ones that leave others scratching their heads—and enjoys the digging process just as much as the final fix.

name: Irina O'Hara
title: Software Engineer
bio: Irina O'Hara is a dedicated software engineer originally from St. Petersburg, Russia, who now calls Utah home. With foundational work experience at several software companies, she has now carved a niche for herself on our frontend team, where she focuses on building quality UI. Irina takes pride in the intellectual rigor of her role and finds immense satisfaction when her efforts come to fruition. She is proficient in a diverse range of technologies, including front-end specialties like JavaScript and React, as well as C#, Razor, SQL, C++, and Python.

name: Jonathan Oliver
title: CEO
bio: As the founder of Smarty, Jonathan provides a great deal to the company. Not only is Jonathan incredibly skilled technically, he also has the incredible leadership ability to see the bigger picture and make the right decision for the future. When Jonathan first started studying for a degree in Computer Science, he quickly noticed that the required readings were either books that he had already read, or books written by authors that he personally knew. Jonathan quickly realized that, while a college degree might be the path normally taken, his skills were already up to the task of trying things out on his own. He soon started successfully consulting for ecommerce companies at the very beginnings of ecommerce, and found that his instincts about his education were correct. Early on, Jonathan saw the benefit of distributed systems. He was both a pioneer in CQRS/Event Sourcing as well as even hosting a successful podcast all about distributed systems. It's thanks to this technical vision that Smarty is able to handle tens of billions of transactions each day with virtually no downtime.

name: Richard Oliver
title: Groundskeeper
bio: Richard Oliver's life story enriches Smarty's grounds. He witnessed the Port Chicago explosion and lived in a home featured in the Academy Award-winning film "All the Kings Men." His career spans academia, sales, gardening at Stony Hill Winery, and managing a Swiss Country Inn. Now at Smarty, he shares joy with his ever-present kind smile and warm demeanor, valued for embodying the beauty in kindness and a life passionately lived.

name: Millie Parson
title: Chief of Staff
bio: A very motivated and driven accounting professional, Millie brings more than 15 years of experience to our finance team. With experience as a Tax Accountant and a Professor of Finance at Brigham Young University's Pathway program, she is well versed with up-to-date practices and procedures. She is a wizard with financial analysis, tax accounting, accounting software, and much more.

name: Brielle Paul
title: Associate Content Writer
bio: Brielle is an Orem native with a passion for all forms of writing, which she channels in her work on the marketing team. With a BA in English from Brigham Young University, she puts her skills to good use, bringing fun and creativity into professional, well-written copy.

name: Sean Paxman
title: Data Acquisition Manager
bio: Builder of data foundations and orchestrator of address data and its vast web of linkages, Sean Paxman evaluates, sources, refines, and feeds information into the products that drive measurable results for Smarty clients.

name: Davin Perkins
title: Manager of Search & Analytics
bio: As our Search Engine Optimization Marketing Team Lead, Davin is likely a big part of the reason that you found Smarty in the first place. He does an excellent job of helping Smarty appear right at the top of relevant searches. Davin has several years of experience in SEO including having developed a network of over 2,000 e-commerce sites for eLearning LLC and even developing over 100 hours of course content related to SEO. He's even developed, maintained, and sold e-commerce businesses that grossed over $1,000,000 in sales.

name: Ryan Peterson
title: IT Associate
bio: Ryan is part of the IT team that keeps our systems running securely and efficiently. He's currently studying Information Technology at UVU, with a focus on networking and system administration. Whether it's solving issues behind the scenes or preventing them in the first place, Ryan brings a steady hand and sharp problem-solving to the job. When he's off the clock, you'll usually find him gaming, reading, or working on side projects.

name: Tommy Peterson
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Tommy Peterson is a seasoned sales professional with a specialized focus on software sales over the last five years. Renowned for his ability to deeply understand client needs, Tommy excels in crafting solutions that not only resolve their challenges but also foster long-lasting partnerships. His commitment to building strong client relationships is matched by his passion for cycling. Whether riding solo, with his family, or coaching a local high school bike team, Tommy brings the same dedication and enthusiasm to the bike trails as he does to his professional endeavors.

name: Maggie Pierce
title: Business Development Representative
bio: Maggie is a Business Development Representative on Smarty's Sales Team, where she helps connect potential customers with the tools they need to solve address data challenges. She brings a thoughtful, solutions-oriented approach to her work and enjoys helping people navigate complexity with greater clarity and confidence. Before joining Smarty, Maggie built a strong background in project management in the solar industry, where she developed a talent for organization, communication, and keeping complex workflows moving forward.

name: Max Pothier
title: Software Engineer
bio: With a history in animation and software QA, Max comes to us with a curiosity and eagerness to learn. He is currently studying software engineering at Utah Valley University, pursuing a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science. As one of our top-notch frontend developers he is daily creating a seamless experience for customers and site visitors.

name: Spencer Powell
title: Principal Product Manager
bio: Spencer Powell might be named after a lake, but he's yet to visit Lake Powell as an adult—go figure! Born in Illinois, raised in St. Louis, he moved to Utah for BYU and got a degree in sound engineering. This led to a 15-year career in ed-tech, where he built recording studios and dove into product management. Now a Principal Product Manager, Spencer is all about guiding company decisions, analyzing market trends, and ensuring every department has what they need. With international experience and a knack for connecting the dots between customers and company roadmaps, Spencer makes sure the product always hits the mark.

name: Molly Remer
title: Marketing Frontend Software Engineer
bio: Before joining Smarty, Molly studied computer science at BYU, where she first met the team through the Women in Computer Science (WICS) Club. After attending a Smarty Lunch and Learn, she didn't just leave inspired—she applied the second there was a job posting. What drew her in was a company that reflected her own values of curiosity, creativity, and genuine human connection. Molly's love of coding sparked early, thanks to her engineer dad, who taught her and her siblings how to solve problems and build things that matter. Outside of work, Molly channels that same focus and joy into the gym, swimming, and crocheting—often to the beat of rap music.

name: Brittany Richards
title: Finance Controller
bio: With a masters in accounting and as a former financial controller for Bloomfield CFO, we are incredibly fortunate to have Brittany and all of her experience here at Smarty. Brittany has managed the internal finances for CPA firms as well as helped prepare tax returns for 20+ subsidiaries for Alliance Data, a fortune 1000 company. At Smarty she helps us be as smart as we can be with our taxes, payroll, and all accounting endeavors.

name: Cody Robertson
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: One of those generally-genius type people, Cody brings a wealth of knowledge and a slew of experience to Smarty every day. He has experience writing embedded software in C++, creating GUIs with Qt, doing SQL database work, database design in GCP, optimizing algorithms, writing Go microservices, using Mithril and React JS, identity and access management, auditing and reporting, and writing Node JS lambdas on AWS. When he's not sitting at a computer blowing us away with his mad skillz, he has been known to keep a vegetable garden, a hive of bees, and a healthy landscape.

name: Jared Robinson
title: Software Engineer
bio: Jared Robinson is a distinguished software engineer with a deep-rooted passion for technological innovation and problem-solving. A proud alumnus of Brigham Young University (BYU), Jared's academic journey was marked not only by rigorous software engineering training but also by his significant contributions as a research assistant. Proficient in a multitude of software languages, Jared's expertise spans C++, SystemVerilog, Python, and beyond.

name: Ben Roden
title: Product Marketing Manager
bio: With more than 10 (but less than 12) years of marketing and communications experience, Ben is a creative force multiplier with a knack for transforming nascent ideas into powerful product stories and user-centric products. Thanks to a background in journalism, Ben is a skilled interviewer and researcher. He loves to transform customer conversations into laser-focused content and product positioning strategies. A veteran of the tech startup world, Ben has a Swiss–Army-skillset encompassing everything from product design and copywriting to media relations and brand strategy.

name: Trey Rutter
title: Dev Ops Engineer
bio: Currently an Information Technology and Cybersecurity student at Brigham Young University, Trey has a love for all things tech. When he isn't behind a computer screen, you can see him on the sidelines at BYU games cheering on the cougars. With technical training in JS, HTML, CSS, Java, SQL, and PHP, he loves all things tech. Whether it be Mac, Linux, or Windows, Trey makes sure our machines are up and running.

name: Jordan Ryan
title: Building Assistant
bio: Jordan Ryan is a mechanical engineer on a mission to change the world—one medical device at a time. As he pursues his PhD in Medical Devices and Design at BYU, he's diving deep into the cutting edge of innovation, merging engineering with healthcare to make a difference. But that's not all—Jordan is also hands-on as a building assistant, managing everything from day-to-day physical issues to large-scale construction projects that keep the property and building running smoothly.

name: Savannah Ryan
title: Software Engineer
bio: Savannah is a dedicated member of our Product Engineering team. She earned her bachelor's degree in computer science from Brigham Young University, along with minors in mathematics and Spanish. She is known for her address expertise, creative solutions, and dedication to mentoring early-career developers; she strives to write clean code with every commit. Beyond her work at Smarty, she's also a passionate advocate for women in STEM. Savannah is a proud mom who spends as much time as possible with her family outside of work.

name: Cas Shaw
title: Senior Business Development Representative
bio: Cas Shaw serves as a Senior Business Development Representative at Smarty, bringing with her a wealth of sales experience garnered from multiple national companies. Raised in Virginia, Cas has cultivated a strong work ethic, which is evident in her efficiency and organizational skills in her professional role. Outside of her professional life, Cas enjoys a balanced lifestyle that includes camping, picnics, and a particular fondness for sushi. She's a dedicated pet owner to two dogs and a uniquely colored pink snake named Peaches, as well as a devoted mother to her son.

name: Freda Shi
title: Software Engineer
bio: Freda Shi is a software engineer on Smarty's backend engineering products team and a fourth-year computer science and applied math student at the University of Utah. She is passionate about building elegant applications of any kind through code. Before Smarty, Freda was a research assistant at the University of Utah, where she worked on graph problems motivated by network fairness. She was also a teaching assistant for various computer science and math classes at the U.

name: Cea Smith
title: Business Development Representative
bio: Cea Smith is a Business Development Representative at Smarty who focuses on helping sales teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence in their data. With experience spanning multiple industries, she spends each day connecting with sales reps and leaders to understand their challenges and introduce tools that streamline workflows and strengthen outreach. Before joining Smarty, Cea spent two years in sales, where she built a strong foundation in prospecting, relationship-building, and customer education.

name: Teresa Snyder
title: Senior Accountant
bio: Originally from the Bay Area, Teresa Snyder moved to Utah with her husband to attend school. Though they planned to return to California, they stayed in Utah, raising their daughters in the local area. As her daughters grew older, Teresa went back to school as a non-traditional student, earning both her bachelor's and master's degrees in Accountancy from BYU. Following graduation, Teresa spent over a decade as an accounting professional in the medical device industry. A homebody at heart, Teresa enjoys quilting, reading WWII historical fiction, and attending family gatherings and activities.

name: Tui Tasini
title: Engineering Project manager
bio: Tui has spent her career wearing many hats—and loving every minute of it. From earning a Graduate Certificate in Cybersecurity to working in QA, Scrum leadership, and product management at Xactware (Verisk), she's built a career around solving problems, leading teams, and getting meaningful work across the finish line. Before joining Smarty as a Project Manager, Tui served as a Principal Project Manager at ReliaQuest, where she continued building on her passion for collaboration, adaptability, and helping complex projects move forward smoothly.

name: Trevor Toolson
title: Account Manager
bio: Trevor has always been the type of person that is not afraid to get things done, no matter how challenging the task or how undesirable the conditions. With years of experience in sales, Trevor loves to be an advocate for his customers and will do everything to create effective solutions for them. As a recent finance graduate from BYU-Hawaii, he loves using financial logic to create the most economical and sensible plans for his clients. Also, he's a pretty easy going guy in case you just wanna shoot the breeze.

name: Andrew Townsend
title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
bio: Andrew didn't set out to land in marketing operations—it just kind of happened. While earning a degree in digital media with an emphasis in cinematography from UVU, he picked up a grab bag of creative and technical skills: web design, coding, Flash animation, 2D/3D design, sound design, video game animation, scriptwriting, camera work, and project management. But through it all, one thing kept pulling him back—people. While working as a freelancer, Andrew got a rush from collaboration and the thrill of problem-solving under pressure.

name: Jenn Turner
title: Office & Hospitality Assistant
bio: Jenn is the kind of person who makes everyone feel like they belong—whether you're a student in her high school classroom or a teammate at Smarty. She's a thoughtful teacher, a generous listener, and someone who approaches every challenge with a warm heart and a can-do attitude. Around here, Jenn's the steady hand and smiling face that everyone's grateful to have on their side.

name: Jennifer Walker
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: A graduate of Brigham Young University with a degree in Computer Science, Jenny is a coding wiz! She is skilled in Go, Java, MySQL, C, and Python, and when we say skilled, we mean skilled. She is also happy to help anyone and has years of experience as an advocate and mentor for women's initiatives in Computer Science. We LOVE having Jenny around!

name: Acacia Warner
title: Software Engineer
bio: Acacia is a bit of a Jill of all trades. A recent graduate of Brigham Young University's Computer Science program, she emphasized in Software Engineering and is a wiz at debugging code! When she's not coding, you can probably find her sharpening her figure skating skills at the ice rink, playing the violin, practicing Chinese folk dance, or cooking dumplings.

name: Lisa Westover
title: Senior Technical Support Representative
bio: Lisa brings a wealth of knowledge to our Customer Support team including a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems with a minor in Computer Science from Utah State University. With experience as a full stack web developer, IT professionals and teachers support, and a computer engineer. Her friendly demeanor and empathetic nature make her a fantastic member of our support team.

name: Dirk Whatcott
title: Operations Engineer Team Lead
bio: Dirk wears several hats at Smarty. He serves as our IT Manager, our Building Manager, an API Data Builder, and several other roles as well. Dirk's primary title however, is Operations Team Lead. He helps us ensure that our systems are running, secure, updated, and consistently monitored. Dirk has held several other IT and development roles at companies such as Symantec and SecurityMetrics, and we benefit greatly from his years of experience.

name: Michael Whatcott
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: Hi there, I'm Michael, and I'm a member of the "Backend Accounts" team, so I get to help maintain a lot of systems surrounding billing, subscriptions, and reporting. I've been at Smarty long enough that I can remember when the architecture truly became a 'distributed system'. I've had the pleasure of designing and building many of our open-source libraries and tools. For me, the most rewarding aspects of working at Smarty are creating interesting systems, learning new things, and sharing what I've learned with others.

name: Scott Wintch
title: Software Engineer
bio: Scott Wintch brings over ten years of software experience in both testing and software development in languages such as Java, Groovy and Grails, SQL, JavaScript, and other various languages. He has a Software Engineering degree from Utah Valley University, where he began his career in the HR software domain in both quality assurance and software development. When he's not working, he loves to spend time with family and friends, playing games, watching movies, and developing new skills in the tech industry.

name: Melissa Wright
title: Legal Administrator
bio: Melissa Wright is a dynamic professional with extensive experience across legal, corporate, government, non-profit, and educational sectors. Known for her adept problem-solving and resource management skills, Melissa has successfully built relationships and achieved goals in various roles. After a noteworthy stint in pharmaceutical sales, she shifted focus to family and entrepreneurship, launching two home-based businesses and diving into community service as Chair of the Highland City Utah Planning Commission. Recently earning a Master Gardener certification, Melissa's passion for gardening encompasses everything from floriculture to beekeeping.

name: Stuart Wright
title: Enterprise Account Executive
bio: Stuart is an optimistic and enthusiastic sales professional with over two decades of experience as a sales leader in the technology and software industries. Stuart currently serves as an Enterprise Account Executive and is responsible for Sales and Partner Development. Prior to joining us in October of 2020, Stuart worked in sales positions for a software engineering services company, and previously, he spent 8 years working with customers and partners in the DoE, Air Force, and other government groups in the High-Performance Computing space.

name: Susan Young
title: Human Resources Manager
bio: Susan brings over 20 years of HR experience from various Utah Valley startups. She excels at working for organizations with strong cultures, focusing on process improvement and the big picture. Her passion centers on people—helping them succeed and encouraging excellence. She's committed to making the workplace exceptional.

name: Benjamin Larson
title: Senior Product Manager
bio: Ben Larson is a serial entrepreneur at heart who loves the entire product lifecycle — from the first customer conversation to the API running reliably at scale — and now channels that as a Senior Product Manager at Smarty, driving roadmap and strategy for the company's address validation, geocoding, and enrichment APIs. He brings 25+ years in software to the role, including as co-founder and VP of Development/Engineering at the edtech company Imagine Learning, CTO and product/commercialization lead at the AI digital-pathology company Techcyte, and earlier engineering roles at LANDesk and Waterford Institute. He started out in Civil Engineering at BYU before his career shifted into software — an engineer's instinct for tradeoffs still shapes how he approaches product work today, from customer discovery to data quality to reliability at scale. Ben loves being part of the Smarty team and the problems we get to solve every day.

name: Vivian Perfetti-Schramm
title: UX Designer
bio: I am a UX Designer with a passion for making human-centered designs, working backward from end-user experiences to ensure accessibility for all. I have experience in energy, publishing, non-profits, and hospitality, giving me insight and empathy on a vast demographic of users. When I am not researching or designing I love to hike and go on outdoor adventures. I also love dogs, especially corgis!
